# static/vendor/

Third-party libraries bundled for offline use.

## qrcode.min.js

- Source: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/qrcodejs/1.0.0/qrcode.min.js
- License: MIT
- Version: 1.0.0

Download manually:
```
curl -o static/vendor/qrcode.min.js https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/qrcodejs/1.0.0/qrcode.min.js
```

If this file is missing, the app will fall back to the CDN version.
